title: FerroAstro scenario (CI-002)
description: Tool-agnostic scenario spec read by FerroAstro and every oracle runner. Generated from ferroastro-scenario; do not edit by hand.

central_body.description: The body that test particles orbit and that perihelia are measured from.

AbmCorrector.description: Predictor–corrector mode of the Adams–Bashforth–Moulton integrator (WP24, NUM-002).

oneOf.description: P, E, C, E.
P(EC)²: P, E, C, E, C (Subbotin et al. 2023; the default).

BodyName.description:
A body a scenario may name. Planets beyond Venus are their system barycentres, as in DE440
(`GM4…GM9` are system GMs); `EMB` is the Earth–Moon barycentre as one body.

oneOf.description: The Sun (NAIF 10).
Mercury (NAIF 1; the barycentre is the planet).
Venus (NAIF 2; the barycentre is the planet).
The Earth (NAIF 399).
The Moon (NAIF 301).
The Earth–Moon barycentre as one body (NAIF 3).
Mars system barycentre (NAIF 4).
Jupiter system barycentre (NAIF 5).
Saturn system barycentre (NAIF 6).
Uranus system barycentre (NAIF 7).
Neptune system barycentre (NAIF 8).
Pluto system barycentre (NAIF 9).

Conformal.description:
`[forces.conformal]`: Mannheim's weak-field conformal-gravity terms, a beyond-GR
**comparison model** (ADR-0016, PHY-020): default off (absent), never part of the GR ladder,
labelled "comparison model" in every report. The Sun-sourced acceleration on a body at
heliocentric position r is −(γc²/2) r̂ + κc² r, with γ = γ* (the Sun's N* = 1) plus γ0 when
`gamma0_centre = "sun"`; with `"uniform"` γ0 instead accelerates every body equally.

Units are those of the published fits: **γ0 and γ\* in cm⁻¹, κ in cm⁻²** (the engine
converts them to km⁻¹ and km⁻² exactly, ×10⁵ and ×10¹⁰). All three are signed (decision D3):
γ > 0 attracts, κ > 0 repels (B ⊃ −κr²). Every field is serialised once the table is present,
so the scenario digest covers the effective values, defaults included; the table itself is
skipped when absent, so existing digests do not change. The published fit values are
unverified (OI-79) and are not defaults: an omitted coefficient is 0.

gamma0.description: Cosmological linear coefficient γ0 (cm⁻¹, signed; default 0).

gamma0_centre.description: Where γ0 is centred: `"sun"` or `"uniform"` (default `"uniform"`, decision D2).

gamma0_direction.description:
For `"uniform"`: the direction (any non-zero length; normalised) towards the uniform
field's distant centre, in the axes of the run's frame (ICRF for n-body runs). Default
`[1, 0, 0]`, an arbitrary choice: the heliocentric observable does not depend on it.

gamma_star.description:
Linear coefficient per solar mass of the source, γ\* (cm⁻¹, signed; default 0). The
source is the Sun, N* = 1.

kappa.description: Quadratic coefficient κ (cm⁻², signed, κ > 0 repulsive; default 0).

EihScope.description:
Which bodies receive and source the 1PN EIH terms (`forces.eih_scope`, NUM-009; maintainer
decision 2026-11-12). Only meaningful with `gr_eih`.

oneOf.description:
DE440 (Park et al. 2021; decision D1 of 2026-10-21): every moving body, Major and Minor,
over the tiered interaction graph, Ring masses as sources. The default.

EPM2021 (Subbotin et al. 2023 §2): only the Major bodies receive and source the 1PN
terms; Minor and Ring bodies stay Newtonian.

ForceKernel.description: The N-body pair kernels (`integrator.force_kernel`, NUM-021, WP26).

oneOf.description: Each pair visited once (`i < j`), fused `r²`, `1/(r²√r²)` (the M3/M4 kernels).

Structure-of-arrays kernels (`ferroastro_forces::soa`): exact `1/r³`, no FMA, sources of
each target summed in storage order; scalar and SIMD lanes are bitwise identical.

Forces.description: `[forces]`: exactly the CI-002 switches. Every switch but `newton` defaults to off.

asteroids.description:
Number of numbered asteroids added as Minor bodies: the first N numbered asteroids of
header.440 in header order (N <= 343), states from the REF-003 sampled file.

conformal.description:
The conformal-gravity comparison model (ADR-0016, PHY-020; n-body mode; not a ladder
switch). Absent by default, and then not serialised, so existing scenario digests are
unchanged.

eih_scope.description:
Which bodies receive and source the 1PN EIH terms (`all`, the default: DE440; `majors`:
EPM2021). Requires `gr_eih` (not a CI-002 switch name; maintainer decision 2026-11-12).

gr_1pn_central.description: 1PN Schwarzschild field of the central body (test-particle mode).

gr_potential.description:
The velocity-independent GR effective potential of the Sun, `−3(GM☉)²/(c²r²)` per unit
mass (Nobili & Roxburgh 1986), with the reaction on the Sun: the GR-potential rung of the
Wisdom–Holman integrator (n-body mode; not a CI-002 switch name, WP29). It gives the 1PN
perihelion advance, but the mean motion is off by O(GM/(ac²)).

kbo_ring.description:
The DE440 KBO ring: 36 fixed Ring masses at 44 au in the ecliptic (provisional, OI-24;
not a CI-002 switch name, WP15).

kbos.description:
The identified Kuiper-belt objects of header.440 as Minor bodies (REF-003, provisional
while OI-24 is open; not a CI-002 switch name, WP15).

lense_thirring.description: Lense–Thirring field of the spinning central body (DE440 solar spin).

major_asteroids.description:
Which of the `asteroids` are Major bodies instead of Minor (NUM-009; not a CI-002 switch
name, WP25). Default `none`.

ppn.description: PPN β, γ of the relativistic terms (default: the DE440 values β = γ = 1).

sun_j2.description: Solar J2 (DE440 `J2SUN`, `ASUN`; with the reaction on the Sun in N-body mode).

Gamma0Centre.description:
Where the cosmological linear term γ0 of the conformal-gravity comparison model is centred
(ADR-0016 decision D2).

oneOf.description:
γ0 is added to the Sun-sourced linear term (γ = γ* + γ0): a constant acceleration
towards the Sun, which changes heliocentric orbits.

γ0 is a uniform field: the same acceleration γ0c²/2 on every body along
`gamma0_direction`. Relative motion is unchanged (the default). A non-zero γ0 is refused
beside `forces.kbo_ring`, whose bodies are fixed and cannot receive the field.
DE440 (`header.440` GROUP 1041, as tabulated in `ferroastro-constants`).

IcBarycentre.description: How the initial conditions are re-barycentred (`initial_conditions.barycentre`, NUM-018).

oneOf.description:
Σ μᵢ* rᵢ = 0 and Σ (μ̇ᵢ* rᵢ + μᵢ* vᵢ) = 0 (Subbotin et al. 2023 Eq. 5), with
μᵢ* = μᵢ [1 + vᵢ²/(2c²) − Σⱼ μⱼ/(2c² rᵢⱼ)] (Park et al. 2021 Eq. 2) and μ̇ᵢ* from the
Newtonian accelerations. Every moving body is translated by the same position and
velocity; fixed Ring masses by the position only.

IcSource.description: Where the initial conditions come from (CI-002: `de440-header | de440-bsp@JD | horizons@JD`).

oneOf.description: The DE440 initial conditions in `header.440` (GROUP 1041, at `JDEPOC`).
`de440.bsp` evaluated at `epoch_jd_tdb`.
JPL Horizons vectors at `epoch_jd_tdb` (supplied to the runner; runners do no network I/O).

barycentre.description:
Re-barycentre the assembled initial conditions (n-body mode; absent: use the source's
states as given). `relativistic` moves the origin to the relativistic SSB with the μᵢ* of
Park et al. 2021 Eqs. 1–2 and the velocity condition with dμ*/dt (NUM-018, OI-75; WP22),
computed in the run's backend (WP25).

epoch_jd_tdb.description:
Epoch (TDB Julian date): required for `de440-bsp` and `horizons`; for `de440-header`,
absent or equal to the header's `JDEPOC`.

IntegratorName.description: Integrator names known to the scenario spec (ADR-0008 and the M4/M5 integrators).

oneOf.description: IAS15-class 15th-order Gauss–Radau (default, ADR-0008).
Adams–Bashforth–Moulton (WP24).
Wisdom–Holman / `WHFast` (WP29).
Gauss–Legendre implicit Runge–Kutta, order 16 (WP29).

IntegratorSpec.description:
`[integrator]`. Unset settings take the integrator's defaults. `epsilon`, `pc_tolerance` and
`dt0_days` configure IAS15 only; `order`, `corrector`, `step_days` and `compensated` configure
ABM only (a key of the other integrator is refused).

compensated.description:
Kahan-compensated state update of ABM and IRK16 (default true; false gives the plain
sums).

dt0_days.description: First trial step in days (N-body default 0.1 d; the controller adapts it).

force_kernel.description:
The N-body pair kernels (NUM-021, WP26): `pairwise` (default) or `soa`. Not a force
switch: it selects FerroAstro's arithmetic, not the physics.

step_days.description:
Fixed step in days of ABM (default 1/16 d), `WHFast` and IRK16 (default 1 d); its sign
follows the span.

MajorAsteroids.description:
Which numbered asteroids are Major bodies (`forces.major_asteroids`, NUM-009, WP25). The
others of `forces.asteroids` stay Minor.

oneOf.description: None: every asteroid is Minor (Newtonian from the Majors only).

(1) Ceres, (2) Pallas, (4) Vesta, (7) Iris and (324) Bamberga, the five asteroids that
obey the EIH equations in the EPM2021 model of Subbotin et al. 2023 §2 (with the Sun, the
planets, the Moon and Pluto: their 16 Major bodies).
Every asteroid of `forces.asteroids`: the all-mutual reference of the tiering check.
Every listed body moves and attracts every other (`ferroastro-forces` N-body model).

Exactly two bodies: `central_body` fixed at the origin, the other a massless test
particle in its field (the single-body rungs, μ = GM of the central body).

Oracle stage B (REF-006, WP17): the first body other than `central_body` is a massless
particle integrated in the central body's frame (μ = GM of the central body) and pulled by
every other listed body, whose positions come from the DE440 SPK (third-body terms with
the indirect part; the field bodies are not integrated). Initial conditions `de440-bsp`.

cadence_days.description: Sample every body's state every this many days (from dense output; absent: no samples).

perihelion.description: Bodies whose perihelion passages relative to `central_body` are located (NUM-010).

sample_bodies.description:
Record only these bodies in each sample (absent: every body). Keeps the output of runs
with hundreds of small bodies small (WP15).

Ppn.description: PPN parameters of the relativistic terms (`ppn{beta,gamma}`, CI-002).

oneOf.description: IEEE-754 binary64.
Double-double (`ferroastro-real`).

The NUM-007 ephemeris precision mode (Subbotin et al. 2023 "mixed"): state, integrator
sums and coefficients in double-double, forces in f64 (n-body mode, WP25).

stop_after_passages.description:
Stop earlier, once this many perihelion passages have been found (the single-body rungs
use orbits + 1).

years.description: Length in Julian years of 365.25 d TDB from the IC epoch; negative integrates backwards.
